profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Vanta
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Vanta.

Primarily a back-end engineer with full-stack experience in the life-science and e-commerce industries, with direct experience leading AI integration and agentic products. 
Previous Senior Software Engineer at Charlie Health, Care/Of, Veeva Systems, and graduate from UC Irvine, Class of 2020.

For any inquiries, please feel free to contact me at brandml2@uci.edu.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Document Management, Policies, and GRC AI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Partner with product, design, and engineering leadership to scope, plan, and iterate on quarterly initiatives that improve clinician experience.
- Technical lead on multi-quarter, cross-team initiative to integrate meeting bots and LLMs into
group therapy sessions through transcription and summarization, leading to reduction in
compliance flags, yearly operating costs, and improved quality of care.
- Technical lead on reverse ETL integration to surface ML model predicted client risks, along
with LLM generated key details and action items from past individual/family therapy sessions.
- Technical lead on overhauling patient detail page to support program type expansion, including integration with drug/alcohol testing vendor.
- Focus: GenAI / LLMs, Python / FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React / Remix

positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Backend engineer responsible for shipping company wide initiatives to drive growth in the business.
- Focus: Ruby/Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, NextJS, AWS SNS, Heroku, Redis, Datadog

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Working under Veeva CRM Transactions on areas such as Call Reporting, Key Medical Insights, and Medical Inquiry to migrate to Salesforce Lightning Experience.
- Focus: Java, HTML, CSS, Javascript, AngularJS, Lightning Web Components, Apex

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Improved the platform by developing new features for nonprofits and users, while catering to
the needs of individual charities.
- Overhauled a donation embed allowing integration of Givsum’s donation features on websites.
- Implemented bidder and table numbers for opportunities, discount codes for purchases, and
live onsite credit card charging directly resulting in more than $100,000 processed.
- Integrated with the Plivo API to set up scheduled and automated SMS services for charities.
- Extracted key data points via integration with Segment and Google Analytics to provide
revenue and user behavior analytics to potential investors.
- Focus: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an iOS and Android connectivity manager using React Native that utilizes inflight
data to forecast connectivity outages on business jets as part of the inCabinExperience team.
- Built a RESTful API using Java Spring Boot and deployed on AWS Elastic Beanstalk that
queries and uses mobile terminal telemetry along with beam coverage areas to dynamically
predict handovers, disconnections, and reconnections in connectivity.
- Generated a cross-language connectivity event detection library via Typescript and JSII.
- Focus: Javascript, React Native, Java, Spring Boot, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, AWS S3
